items.title: Jensen Huang affair in D.C.: Resignation calls and moves to tighten Nvidia China exports

items.title: Hormuz Strait will ‘never return’ to pre-war status, Iran’s Ghalibaf says
items.summary: Iran's parliament speaker and top negotiator says Tehran is waiting for an official US response to its seven conditions.
items.why_relevant: 霍尔木兹海峡地缘风险

confirmed_facts.text: Hormuz Strait will ‘never return’ to pre-war status, Iran’s Ghalibaf says Iran’s parliament speaker and top negotiator says Tehran is waiting for an official US response to its seven conditions for ending war.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Hormuz Strait will ‘never return’ to pre-war status, Iran’s Ghalibaf says Iran’s parliament speaker and top negotiator says Tehran is waiting for an official US response to its seven conditions for ending war.

confirmed_facts.text: Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Iran’s parliament speaker and top negotiator, has told Al Jazeera that the Strait of Hormuz will “never return” to its status prior to the US-Israel war on Iran.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Iran’s parliament speaker and top negotiator, has told Al Jazeera that the Strait of Hormuz will “never return” to its status prior to the US-Israel war on Iran.

confirmed_facts.text: In an exclusive interview published on Wednesday, Ghalibaf said Iran and Oman reached an understanding to oversee the critical waterway as part of Tehran’s seven-point proposal to end the eight-month conflict.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: In an exclusive interview published on Wednesday, Ghalibaf said Iran and Oman reached an understanding to oversee the critical waterway as part of Tehran’s seven-point proposal to end the eight-month conflict.

confirmed_facts.text: “There are no ‘free waters’ [international waters] there, and the 1982 [UN Convention on the Law of the Sea] does not apply to the strait … The regulations within the Strait of Hormuz are governed by the laws of the two littoral states that border it,” he said.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: “There are no ‘free waters’ [international waters] there, and the 1982 [UN Convention on the Law of the Sea] does not apply to the strait … The regulations within the Strait of Hormuz are governed by the laws of the two littoral states that border it,” he said.

confirmed_facts.text: Seven conditions Ghalibaf said Tehran provided a clear response to the US through a Qatari mediator that included its seven conditions for peace talks, adding that Iran is waiting for an official response.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Seven conditions Ghalibaf said Tehran provided a clear response to the US through a Qatari mediator that included its seven conditions for peace talks, adding that Iran is waiting for an official response.

confirmed_facts.text: Iran’s conditions, as outlined by the chief negotiator, include lifting the US-imposed naval blockade and sanctions, the release of Iranian frozen funds, ending fighting on all fronts, and an explicit announcement of an end to the war.

items.title: Low-hanging fruit for Xi and Trump to pluck at Shenzhen Apec summit
items.summary:
The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit is set to take place in Shenzhen on November 18 and 19. Shenzhen will also be playing host to the first of two further meetings between Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump this year.
When the two leaders met in May and September, they called for “constructive strategic stability” as a prescription for US-China relations. Both sides are keen to maintain the fragile detente, in part due to domestic considerations.
